about_the_game:
Shape Shards is a dynamic action roguelike that combines skill-based combat, deep customization, and distinctive geometric visuals into a compelling and replayable adventure.

Fluid and Skillful Combat

Combat in Shape Shards is designed for precision and strategy. Every enemy encounter rewards careful timing, thoughtful positioning, and skill-based resource management. Master unique weapon combos, exploit clearly telegraphed enemy attacks, and utilize a variety of items to overcome diverse challenges.

Deep Customization and Build Variety

Customize your character's abilities and playstyle extensively through spells, passive items, and elemental infusions. Discover powerful synergies, unlock game-changing modifiers, and experiment freely with numerous build possibilities. Whether you favor aggressive melee strategies, skill-based ranged combat, or versatile spellcasting, Shape Shards empowers you to create and refine a truly personalized approach.

Innovative Elemental and Spell Systems

Harness the power of distinct elemental interactions—Fire, Ice, Lightning, Dark, Wind, and Physical—each with unique mechanics. Integrate spells seamlessly into combat, complementing weapon attacks to shape battles according to your strategic vision. From offense-focused spellcasting to defensive and supportive loadouts, the game's rich elemental system offers thoughtful depth.

Strategic Exploration and Progression

Navigate procedurally generated dungeons filled with meaningful choices and thoughtful opportunities. Decide carefully between loot, elemental upgrades, and more. Each choice significantly impacts your run, ensuring no two playthroughs feel the same, and offering endless opportunities for discovery and mastery.

Embark on an endlessly engaging journey in Shape Shards, where every run presents fresh skill-based challenges, rewarding depth, and exciting combat encounters tailored by your unique choices and strategies.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS (64-bit) or newer
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectSound-compatible audio device
  • VR Support: None (not VR-compatible)
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (64-bit) or newer
  • Processor: Quad-core 3.0 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 960
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectSound-compatible audio device
  • VR Support: None (not VR-compatible)
